i.norm: Verifies that {@code DurationUtils.get()} returns a non-null Duration when the requested system property does not exist, falling back to a negative default value. Steps: 1. Convert {@code TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS} to its {@code ChronoUnit} equivalent (MILLIS). 2. Call {@code get()} with a property key that is guaranteed not to exist as a JVM system property, so the method uses the supplied default value (-210 ms). 3. Assert that the returned {@code Duration} is not null.
Convert the Java-concurrent TimeUnit to its java.time ChronoUnit counterpart
Use a key that will never match a real system property, forcing the default value
get() looks up the system property; on a miss it creates a Duration from the default
